_comment: Fishing (v0.94.0, stage 1 of claude/design-fishing.md). PLACEHOLDERS by the assistant: every fish, number and line; the user has fishing, the Watermen and Anglers' Guild (surname Waters) and its tackleman. waters: city_river (Bytorsskug's river), river (the Brisering's river), lake (Brisering waters of 25+ cells), pond (smaller). depth: shore, shallow, deep (cells from the bank: 1, 2, 3+). light: lit, dark or any (a water's light follows the Duel: south of Myligast is lit in the Light Duel). baits: bait id -> how much it likes it (0-1). temper: calm, runner, thrasher, sulker, diver, biter (see game/fishing.py). kg: [usual, spread]. per_kg: shards a kilo before the tackleman's cut. wary: a shorter bite and a harder strike.

silt_minnow.name: silt minnow
silt_minnow.description: A finger of grey silver that lives anywhere there's silt to nose through. Everyone's first fish.

bridge_perch.name: bridge perch
bridge_perch.description: Striped and bold, it holds in the still water under Bytorsskug's bridges while the light lasts.

lampfin.name: lampfin
lampfin.description: Its fins catch any light at all. It gathers where the city's lamps reach the water, Duel in, Duel out.

gutter_eel.name: gutter eel
gutter_eel.description: A brown eel of drains and bank holes. It fights like a dropped rope.

stonecat.name: stonecat
stonecat.description: Whiskered, flat-headed, grey as a river stone. It feeds in the dark and lies like one when hooked.

reedrunner.name: reedrunner
reedrunner.description: Lean and green-backed, it hunts the river's edges in the light and runs for the reeds the moment it feels a hook.

bargefish.name: bargefish
bargefish.description: Broad as a plank and about as lively, until it decides otherwise. River people say they follow the current down to the miasma and come back bigger.

glasstooth.name: glasstooth
glasstooth.description: A long hunter with clear, needle teeth. It takes only what moves, and it bites through a careless line.

lake_perch.name: lake perch
lake_perch.description: The common perch of the Brisering's still waters, in schools at the edges while it's light.

moonbream.name: moonbream
moonbream.description: Round and pale as the moon it's named for. It rises to feed only in the dark.

gloamfish.name: gloamfish
gloamfish.description: A deep-water fish with eyes too big for its head. Hooked, it goes straight down.

mirecarp.name: mirecarp
mirecarp.description: A heavy, gold-brown grubber of lake beds. It can sulk on the bottom for a long time.

ghost_char.name: ghost char
ghost_char.description: Nearly white, nearly invisible in the dark water. Seen more often than caught.

lakeback.name: great lakeback
lakeback.description: Armoured down its back like a boat's keel, and older than anyone fishing for it. The lake people call it the lake-king.

pond_loach.name: pond loach
pond_loach.description: A whiskered little bottom-dweller of every pond and puddle on the Brisering.

ambient: A weed drifts past your line.

bite.calm: The float dips and holds under!

left.text: It veers left, toward a snag!

right.text: It veers right, toward a snag!

spent.text: It's spent, coming in on its side.

scarred.name: scarred
scarred.note: Old hook scars at the lip. Someone nearly had it.
